title: How is Hitler connected to Spider-Man?
description: Six real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Spider-Man, through a Norwegian skating star, King Olav V, Queen Elizabeth II, Queen Camilla and Andrew Garfield.
hook: How is Hitler connected to Spider-Man?
fun_fact: After winning her third Olympic gold in 1936, Sonja Henie accepted Hitler's invitation to lunch at Berchtesgaden, and he gave her a signed photo of himself.
research_note: Instead of the usual Chamberlain or Mussolini exit, this chain leaves Hitler through skater Sonja Henie, whose 1968 museum opening with King Olav V leads straight into the royals; a Tom Holland ending through Benedict Cumberbatch only had tiny group shots, while Andrew Garfield came to Comic-Con 2013 in the Spider-Man suit.

links.line: In the 1930s, Hitler shook hands with Norway's skating star, Sonja Henie.
In 1968, Henie walked Norway's King Olav into her new art museum.

where.place: Henie Onstad Art Centre, Høvikodden, Norway

image.file: File:Dronning Elisabeth II besøker Norge i august 1969 - PA-0797 6007A 013.jpg

links.line: In 1969, King Olav hosted Queen Elizabeth on her visit to Norway.

image.file: File:The Queen and the Duchess of Cornwall.JPG

links.line: In 2013, the Queen watched the royal flypast beside her son's wife, Camilla.
In 2025, Camilla, now Queen, welcomed Andrew Garfield to Buckingham Palace.
And in 2012, Andrew Garfield swung into theaters as the Amazing Spider-Man.
